method: Twelve alternating 120-frame old/new intervals in one frozen production fixture; median of six interval statistics per style, not pooled p95. Exact full world/narrative serialization equality checked after every interval. Separate process-first construction observations include JIT/lazy loading but not deferred GPU completion.
environment: Debian 13; Godot 4.6.1 .NET; GL Compatibility; llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7; Xorg dummy over TCP; 1280x800 mobile layout; 1.5x unchanged zoom; no VSync. No concurrent local test/build workload during the accepted comparison.
limits: Not physical Galaxy S25 or emulator performance.
Earlier prototypes and independent-process pairs varied widely, including regressions; raw observations are retained.
No GPU timer-query attribution, cold-machine or process working-set measurement.
Native counters cover all game textures/buffers; staging vertex payload is an estimator, not isolated GPU VBO memory.
Batched vertex counts exclude the unchanged immediate grass/dirt texture quads and actors/UI.
A bounded rebuild observation is not long-session leak proof.
